€1Ā. (स्कन्दते) 
__1 To jump. 
__2 To raise. 
__3 To pour out, emit.

P. (स्कन्दति, स्कन्न) 
__1 To leap, jump. 
__2 To rise, ascend, jump upwards. 
__3 To fall, drop; स्यन्त्वा स्यन्त्वा दिवः शम्भोर्मूर्ध्नि स्कन्त्वा भुवं गताम् [[

.]] 
__4 To burst or leap out. 
__5 To perish, come to an end; चस्कन्दे तप ऐश्वरम् [[

.]] 
__6 To be spilled, ooze. 
__7 To emit, shed. 
__8 To go, move. 
__9 To become dry. 
__10 To perish. -Caus. (स्कन्दयति-ते) 
__1 To pour out, effuse, shed, emit (as the seminal fluid); एकः शयीत सर्वत्र न रेतः स्कन्दयेत् क्वचित् [[

[स्कन्द्-अच्] 
__1 Leaping. 
__2 Quicksilver. 
__3 N. of Kārtikeya; सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः [[

.]] 
__4 N. of Śiva. 
__5 The body. 
__6 A king. 
__7 The bank of a river. 
__8 A clever man. 
__9 A kind of disease common to children. 
__10 Effusion, spilling. 
__11 Perishing, destruction. 
-Comp. 
-अंशकः quicksilver. 
-जननी N. of Parvatī. 
-जित् N. of Viṣṇu. 
-पुत्रः a son of Skanda (euphemistic term for a thief); प्रथममेतत् स्कन्दपुत्राणां सिद्धिलक्षणम् [[

̭13.]] 
-पुराणम् one of the 18 Purāṇas. 
-मातृ f. N. of Durgā. 
-षष्ठी 
__1 a festival in honour of Kārtikeya on the sixth day of Chaitra. 
__2 The 6th day of the light half of the कार्तिक month.

[स्कन्द्-ल्युट्] 
__1 Emission, effusion. 
__2 Purging, looseness, relaxation (of the bowels). 
__3 Going, moving. 
__4 Drying up. 
__5 The suppression of bleeding by cold applications.
p. p. Emitted, effused, shed; मोघं स्कन्दितमार्षभम् [[

p. p. 
__1 Fallen down, descended. 
__2 Oozed out, or trickled down. 
__3 Emitted, effused, sprinkled. 
__4 Gone. 
__5 Dried up.
[स्कन्द्यते आरुह्यतेऽसौ सुखेन शाखया वा कर्मणि घञ् पृषो°; cf. [[

.]] 
__2 The body; सूक्ष्मयोनीनि भूतानि तर्कगम्यानि कानिचित् । पक्ष्मणोऽपि निपातेन येषां स्यात् स्कन्धपर्ययः ॥ [[

.]] 
__3 The trunk or stem of a tree; तीव्राघातप्रतिहततरुस्कन्धलग्नैकदन्तः [[Ś. 1. 32]]; [[

.]] 
__4 A branch or large bough; स्कन्धाधिरूढोज्ज्वलनीलकण्ठान् [[Śi. 4. 7.]] 
__5 A department or branch of human knowledge; [[Śi. 2. 28.]] 
__6 A chapter, section, division (of a book). 
__7 A division or detachment of an army; द्वितीयं प्रेषयामास बलस्कन्धं युधिष्ठिरः [[

.]] 
__8 A troop, multitude, group; ‘स्कन्धः स्यान्नृपतौ वंशे साम्परायसमूहयोः’

.]] 
__9 The five objects of sense. 
__10 The five forms of mundane consciousness (in Buddhistic phil.); सर्वकार्यशरीरेषु मुक्त्वाड्गस्कन्धपञ्चकम् [[Śi. 2. 28.]] 
__11 War, battle. 
__12 A king. 
__13 An agreement. 
__14 A road, way; [[

.]] 
__15 A wise or learned man. 
__16 A heron. 
__17 Articles used at the coronation of a king. 
__18 A part (अंश); तदवध्यानविस्रस्तपुण्यस्कन्धस्य भूरिदः [[

.]] 
-न्धा 
__1 A branch. 
__2 A creeper. 
-Comp. 
-अग्निः, -अनलः the trunk of a tree set on fire, fire made with thick logs. 
-आवारः 
__1 an army or a division of it; स्कन्धाबारमसौ निवेश्य बिषमे सौवेलमूर्ध्नि स्वयम् [[

]]; [[Dūtavākyam 1.]] 
__2 a royal capital or residence; तत्तु दृष्ट्वा पुरं तच्च स्कन्धाबारं च पाण्डबाः [[
]]; उपप्लव्यं स गत्वा तु स्कन्धाबारं प्रविश्य च [[

.]] 
-उपानेय a. to be carried on the shoulders. 
(-यः) a form of peace-offering in which fruit or grain is presented, as a mark of submission. 
-घनः cognition; अन्यस्मिन् स्कन्धघनेऽन्येन स्कन्धघनेन यज्ज्ञानं तत् तत्संततिजेनान्येनोपलभ्यते नातत्संततिजेनान्येन । तस्मात् शून्याः स्कन्धघना इति [[ŚB. on

.]] 
-चापः a sort of pole or yoke for carrying burdens; cf. शिक्य (Mar. कावड). 
-जः a tree growing from a principal stem. 
-तरुः the cocoa-nut tree. 
-देशः 
__1 the shoulder; इदमुपहितसूक्ष्मग्रन्थिना स्कन्धदेशे [[Ś. 1. 19.]] 
__2 that part of the elephant's body, where the driver sits. 
__3 the stem of a tree. 
-परिनिर्वाणम् the annihilation of the elements of being (with Buddhists). 
-पीठम् the shoulder-blade. 
-फलः 
__1 the cocoa-nut tree. 
__2 the Bilva tree. 
__3 the glomerous fig-tree. 
-बन्धना a sort of fennel. 
-मल्लकः a heron. 
-रुहः the (Indian) figtree. 
-वाहः, -वाहकः an ox trained to carry burdens, pack-bullock. 
-शाखा a principal branch, the forked branch issuing from the upper stem of a tree. 
-शृङ्गः a buffalo. 
-स्कन्धः every shoulder.

n. 
__1 The shoulder. 
__2 The trunk of a tree.
An ox trained to carry burdens; cf. स्कन्धबाह.

a. 
(-नी f.) 
__1 Having shoulders. 
__2 Having branches or a branched stem. -m. A tree.

__2 Fulcrum. 
__3 The Supreme Being.
